editorial.blurb: Hunan Grill brings authentic Hunan-style skewers and boldly spiced dishes to life with quality meats sourced from China and a friendly, cozy atmosphere.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the spicy option if you enjoy heat—reviewers confirm they don't hold back. Use the self-service phone ordering system for convenience, and go for the lamb skewers, pork belly skewers, and stinky tofu, which the kitchen executes well.
